title: test: a refused Observer::from_group_info stores nothing
description: krmn K4: Observer::from_group_info deletes the PublicGroup on a refused tree (PublicGroup::delete), but no test proves the store is empty afterwards: Observer has no accessor for stored state. Add a store-level check (e.g. via mimi_mls::Store test hook or by attempting a reload) or a minimal accessor, with a regression test.
close_reason: Test refused_observer_stores_nothing (member_external_join.rs) counts openmls_group_data rows: 0 after a refused from_group_info, >0 after a valid one. Passed at once (missing test, not a bug); proven able to fail by removing PublicGroup::delete (4 rows left), delete restored.
